campaign.title: Rename G40_13_PROVIDER while preserving identity and bindings.

initial.code:
FUNCTION G40_13_PROVIDER(X)
  G40_13_PROVIDER = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    G40_13_PROVIDER = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 101) THEN
    G40_13_PROVIDER = 101
  END IF
  G40_13_PROVIDER = G40_13_PROVIDER
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION G40_13_PRED_1(X)
  G40_13_PRED_1 = 0
  IF (G40_13_PROVIDER(X) >= 50) THEN
    G40_13_PRED_1 = 1
  END IF
  G40_13_PRED_1 = G40_13_PRED_1
END FUNCTION
